cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?
